en: The image depicts a black-and-white photograph of a medieval stone tower with a conical roof and weather vane, integrated into a defensive wall. The tower rises above an arched gateway through which several people can be seen walking on a cobblestone street. Surrounding the tower are old buildings with steeply pitched roofs. The building to the left has writing on the wall in a language using the Latin alphabet.
